An '''OverPrecinct''' was an organizational level of [[Locational Enforcement/Legends|Locational Enforcement]], which was part of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. OverPrecincts were assigned to a [[Territory]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
